mapper.select: SELECT id, subscription_id AS subscriptionId, user_id AS userId, job_id AS jobId, job_title AS jobTitle, company_name AS companyName, matched_at AS matchedAt, is_read AS isRead FROM notifications WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
